title: Reject native door geometry diverging from exported physical definitions
acceptance: Validate actual closed evaluated vertices and ownership against the authoritative door definition before re-export.
Explicitly reject unsupported root/leaf transforms and vertex edits that would leave stale closed pose, hinge, dimensions or handle metadata; current published B6 master must pass.
No model mutation or regeneration: pure validator plus actionable door/part errors, root wires native Blender adapter and audit.
verification: Meaningful regression for root translation, per-leaf translation/rotation, edited shape and ownership; current actual exported geometry validation without Blender.
notes: Direct fix for independent read-only review finding; no recursive BMAD, GPU, Blender, fullsuite or server.
